journey.name: Create first outfit
journey.description: From the empty Outfits tab, opens the Create-outfit sheet and verifies its fields. Start state: fresh install with no saved outfits.

actions.action: Tap the "OUTFITS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Outfits screen shows the empty state: the "No outfits yet" title and a "Create your first outfit" button.
Tap the "Create your first outfit" button.
Verify the "Create outfit" sheet is shown with an "Outfit name (optional)" field and a "Select items" section.
Verify the "Save outfit" button is present in the sheet.
